result: Stopped for a ruling: Liella ships no C library headers (programs build against system headers), so COMPAT-ONLY header hiding and the tmpnam header warning have no target; no code changed

rulings.item: Where COMPAT-ONLY declarations and the tmpnam warning live while Liella has no C headers
rulings.recommendation: (a) defer the header part of R0/R1/R2/R4/R7/R8 to a future Liella C headers story; exports unchanged, no differences row or COMPAT id needed yet. Alternatives: (b) opt-in lint header with #pragma GCC poison + deprecated redeclarations; (c) .gnu.warning.<sym> link-time warnings after a black-box probe

rulings.item: Flag name and kind if option (b) is chosen

informational: docs/compat-flags.md uses COMPAT-11 twice; CLAUDE.md says a static check rejects duplicate ids but none exists in xtask/src
